race.comment: HELLA FAST (1) returns and steps out in new colours. The form around him last prep reads a treat and he's been bought up to the mark with two nice trials. Gets a great chance to break a long run of outs. BARBARIAN KING (9) has made an encouraging return and while he boasts a solid record here he needs to find the winning edge. Drops back slightly in trip off a month between and is a genuine chance to land the knockout blow this time. MARELLITY (10) hasn't been far away since resuming and should be nearing a peak effort now. Draws to be blending in at the right time and is a chance to break the drought. MELO MELO KAVA (7) was good fresh before failing last time. Shoulders a better record back to this trip and is one to keep safe in the minors.
